content: आयु {%a.%} [इ-ठण् <ls>Uṇ. 1. 2</ls>] <ab>Ved.</ab> Living, going, movable. .{@-युः@} .²1 A living being, man. .²2 Mankind, human race. .²3 Living beings taken collectively. .²4 The first man. .²5 Life, duration of life. .²6 Wind, अहं केशरिणः क्षेत्रे वायुना जगदायुना <ls>Mb.</ls> .²7 A son, descendant, offspring. .²8 The son of Purūravas and Urvaśī.
